messages.content: Find the smallest positive integer $n$ such that $n!$ ends in exactly $10$ trailing zeros.

The number of trailing zeros of $n!$ is $Z(n) = \lfloor n/5 \rfloor + \lfloor n/25 \rfloor + \dots$

$Z(40) = \lfloor 40/5 \rfloor + \lfloor 40/25 \rfloor = 8 + 2 = 10$, so the smallest such $n$ is $40$.
